subject: [PATCH 05/11] nfsd: set ctime when a SETATTR with delegated times changes other attributes

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where the ctime (creation time) is not updated when a client holding a delegation sends a SETATTR request that changes other attributes, such as mode or owner, along with the atime. The patch adds ATTR_CTIME to the iattr unless it's a delegated atime-only update, ensuring that the ctime is always updated in these cases.
